description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'PayGrade' entity for the OrangeHRM system, including properties, constructor, and getter/setter methods for handling pay grade data within the HR management system.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: Entity class representing a pay grade, with properties for ID, name, and associated pay grade currencies, along with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the pay grade.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the pay grade.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the pay grade.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of associated PayGradeCurrency entities.

methods.name: setPayGradeCurrencies
methods.description: Associates a collection of PayGradeCurrency entities with this pay grade.
